metricDefinitions.carriedForward: still unresolved immediately before that release
metricDefinitions.resolvedOrSuperseded: resolution or supersession release is that release
metricDefinitions.currentlyPartiallyResolvedAmongKnown: current audit classification among records known by then; not a reconstructed historical transition
metricDefinitions.currentlyFlaggedSilentDropAmongKnown: current audit flag among records known by then
metricDefinitions.explicitReappearances: an explicit later appearance recorded after at least one intervening public release
metricDefinitions.totalKnownOpenAfterRelease: introduced minus resolved or superseded through that release
